data.narrative:
Resolute Grid operates in the Climate & Energy sector at the seed stage. The comparable universe includes 9 peers across Climate & Energy—1 public company (LNZA) and 8 private firms including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

The peer-median method is not applicable. Despite identifying 9 same-sector peers, fewer than three comparables meet narrow stage or valuation-tier filters. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material cross-sector bias and misrepresent Resolute Grid's position within the Climate & Energy landscape. This filtering constraint limits triangulation to a single methodological anchor.

The absence of sufficient same-stage and valuation-comparable peers creates a material gap in quantitative valuation support. Without a robust peer median, complementary approaches—such as precedent transaction analysis within Climate & Energy, discounted cash flow modeling, or venture capital method frameworks—would be necessary to establish a credible valuation range. The current dataset does not provide the inputs required for these methods. A valuation conclusion is therefore not supported by available data. Prospective investors should expand the comparable set to include earlier-stage climate companies or supplement analysis with forward-looking financial modeling and market-sizing work specific to Resolute Grid's subsector and technology.
